tracks.title: Local Only
tracks.about: No account, no server, no analytics. A pulse, an organ, and the sound of not being tracked.

tracks.title: Clean Build
tracks.about: Two guitars disagree until the piano gets them building the same thing. Warnings are not errors. Mostly.

tracks.title: Passkey
tracks.about: A key you never see, a lock you never pick, and a choir that refuses to explain itself.

tracks.title: Upfront
tracks.about: Heavy and slow to anger. The price is on the page, and the choir is the receipt.

tracks.title: Search, Sorted
tracks.about: Six sources shout at once. Apple Intelligence quietly tells four of them to sit down.

tracks.title: Clock Out
tracks.about: A pipe organ, a choir, and the exact moment the timer stops. The loudest guitars on the record are the overtime.

tracks.title: No Ads, Ever
tracks.about: Nothing flashing, nothing selling. A piano keeps count; the strings do the work.

tracks.title: Version 27
tracks.about: Built once, built well, and shipped before the OS changed its mind. The last track turns major and keeps going.
